The official Osun service verifies CofO/survey-plan documents but no public Ilesa parcel viewer or safe parcel geometry endpoint was identified.

queries.result: No Yoruba-language first-party public parcel map or anonymous parcel geometry service for Ilesa was found. Search results led to the same Osun government land-document service and general official survey/cadastral-request information; no city-local parcel layer was evidenced.

registryBasis: The Osun Ministry of Lands service is first-party and state-level, but its public workflow is document/survey-plan verification rather than a browsable Ilesa cadastral registry or map. OSGOF describes general cadastral-survey requests. Neither source evidences public Ilesa parcel coverage.

requests.outcome: Retrieved the current Next.js page. It identifies the Osun Ministry of Lands and Physical Planning and offers CofO and survey-plan verification; no map, parcel layer, or citywide feature service is exposed in the page.

Inspected the current JavaScript configuration. It exposes POST https://3uj5gmztd2.eu-west-2.awsapprunner.com/api/v1/verify and encrypts CofO/survey-plan document inputs before submission. No parcel map/API route or geometry schema was present.
Returned the public API welcome response. This confirms the service host but not cadastral parcel coverage.
Returned 404 E_ROUTE_NOT_FOUND for GET; the discovered route is POST-only. No POST was attempted because it requires an encrypted document number/date and is not a parcel geometry endpoint.

Retrieved the official federal surveyor-general site. It advertises requests for maps, coordinates, and cadastral surveys, but no anonymous Ilesa parcel map/API or safe parcel feature response was found.
Retrieved the official Osun Ilesa page. It confirms the city and state-government context but exposes no cadastral map or parcel service.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Osun land-document verification is state-level; OSGOF is federal survey/cadastral service information.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service pages and current client configuration were inspected; no public Ilesa parcel layer, safe native parcel ID, schema, CRS, or geometry response was verified.

technicalBlocker: The only discovered Osun API route is a document-verification POST requiring encrypted CofO/survey-plan identifiers. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe owner/address fields, or TLS exception was used.
remainingUncertainty: Ilesa municipal or state cadastral data may exist behind an unpublished, offline, paid, or authenticated workflow; the searches and exact WUP point do not establish citywide absence.
pointBasis: Exact WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement point; not shifted to force a parcel hit.
